Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows two pulmonary nodules (indicated by arrows), one in the right middle lobe region and another in the retrocardiac area. In the context of DIPNECH (Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia), nodules larger than 5 mm are classified as carcinoid tumors, whereas those smaller than 5 mm are tumorlets; the visible size and specific distribution favor carcinoids associated with this syndrome.
